lines.en: Let me ask you, why is everybody using these tiny little lights nowadays?
I remember when people used to use big lights.
Monica's letting other people help decorate her tree.
Did someone get her drunk again?
Having a perfectly decorated tree is not what Christmas is about.
It's about being with the people that you love.
I don't know what it is.
It just doesn't quite feel like Christmas to me.
See, now it feels like Christmas.
